/bin/bash -lc "jq -r '. as "'$s | .stack_frames[] | [., $s.value] | @tsv'"' samples.jsonl | awk -F '\\t' '{sum["'$1]+=$2; pos[$1]+=($2>0?$2:0); neg[$1]+=($2<0?-$2:0); n[$1]++} END {for(k in sum) printf "%+d'"\\t%d\\t%d\\t%d\\t%s\\n\",sum[k],pos[k],neg[k],n[k],k}' | sort -nr | head -80
jq -r '[.value, (.labels.source_session[0]), (.stack_frames[3] // \"\"), (.stack_frames[2] // \"\"), (.stack_frames[1] // \"\"), (.stack_frames[0] // \"\")] | @tsv' samples.jsonl | awk -F '\\t' '{key="'$3; s[key]+=$1; p[key]+=($1>0?$1:0); n[key]+=($1<0?-$1:0); c[key]++} END{for(k in s) printf "%+d'"\\t%d\\t%d\\t%d\\t%s\\n\",s[k],p[k],n[k],c[k],k}' | sort -nr"

/bin/bash -lc "sed -n '1,240p' README.md
jq -r '[.value, .stack_frames[3], .labels.source_session[0]] | @tsv' samples.jsonl | awk -F '\\t' '"'$2=="strategy:wait"{if($1>0){p+=$1; ps[$3]+=$1}else{n+=-$1; ns[$3]+=-$1}} END{for(k in ps){u++; if(ns[k]>0)b++; if(ps[k]>ns[k])x++} for(k in ns) if(!(k in ps)) onlyn++; printf "candidate_weight=%d base_weight=%d net=%+d sessions_candidate=%d sessions_both=%d sessions_candidate_excess=%d sessions_base_only=%d'"\\n\",p,n,p-n,u,b,x,onlyn}'
jq -r '[.value, .stack_frames[3], .labels.source_session[0]] | @tsv' samples.jsonl | awk -F '\\t' '"'$2=="strategy:wait"{s[$3]+=$1;p[$3]+=($1>0?$1:0);n[$3]+=($1<0?-$1:0)} END{for(k in s) printf "%+d'"\\t%d\\t%d\\t%s\\n\",s[k],p[k],n[k],k}' | sort -nr | head -20"
